title: seed: a composite externalId record with one component authored blank inserts another row on every load, with no warning
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

Finding reported by area o3-G while building PR #34854 (#34800), report 6950154378. It was measured. A seat-filed card: grading and `domain:*` belong to triage.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:server · size S
Dedupe words: seed composite externalId blank component duplicate

## What happens

A seed record on an object with a composite `externalId` has one key component authored blank. On every load, that record inserts another row: the table went from 2 to 3 to 4 rows over three loads. Nothing warns.

The #28952 warning fires only when every record keys empty, so a record with a single blank component goes unnoticed.

## Expected

Either the load warns, naming the record and the blank component, or such a record is refused at validation the way an unkeyable seed is. It must not insert a duplicate on every load.

Related: #28952 (the all-empty warning), #34800 / PR #34854, #34613.
